description: Algorithmic bias can lead to discriminatory outcomes in healthcare, such as black patients receiving less care than white counterparts due to flawed label choices.

instances.assertion: Algorithmic bias can lead to discriminatory outcomes in healthcare, such as black patients receiving less care than white counterparts due to flawed label choices.
AI systems can lead to discriminatory outcomes in healthcare, such as black patients receiving less care than white patients due to biased algorithmic design.
Algorithmic bias often stems from biased training data or flawed objective functions, leading to discriminatory outcomes in healthcare and employment.
